source_policydoc: Directive 2010/75/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council
justification: The implementation of the Directive 2010/75/EU can aid the achievement of the Energy from Renewable Sources target by promoting the use of renewable energy sources, which in turn can support the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions and improve air quality.

source_policydoc: On the quality of water intended for human consumption
impact_policydoc: On ensuring a level playing field for sustainable air transport
justification: The implementation of the On the quality of water intended for human consumption policy document can create conditions that further the On ensuring a level playing field for sustainable air transport target by reducing pollution from aviation, which can improve air quality and public health.

source_policydoc: Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan
justification: The Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan can have a significant positive impact on the Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy by promoting sustainable transportation modes, reducing emissions, and improving air quality, which can reinforce the strategy's objectives.

source_policydoc: European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials
impact_policydoc: On the deployment of alternative fuels infrastructure
justification: The European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials can aid the On the deployment of alternative fuels infrastructure target by promoting the development and use of sustainable and safe chemicals and materials, which can support the transition to alternative fuels and reduce environmental impacts.

source_policydoc: On reporting of environmental data from industrial installations and establishing an Industrial Emissions Portal
impact_policydoc: On the Energy Transition of the EU Fisheries and Aquaculture sector
justification: The On reporting of environmental data from industrial installations and establishing an Industrial Emissions Portal policy document can create conditions that further the On the Energy Transition of the EU Fisheries and Aquaculture sector target by providing data and insights on emissions and environmental impacts, which can support the development of sustainable fisheries and aquaculture practices.

source_policydoc: On ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe
justification: The On ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe policy document can reinforce the Hydrogen Strategy by promoting the use of clean energy sources, such as hydrogen, which can improve air quality and reduce emissions.

impact_policydoc: The new EU Urban Mobility Framework
justification: The Biofuels - Directive (EU) 2023/2413 can create conditions that further The new EU Urban Mobility Framework target by promoting the use of biofuels and low-carbon fuels in transportation, which can support the development of sustainable urban mobility systems.

source_policydoc: On ensuring a level playing field for sustainable air transport
justification: The On ensuring a level playing field for sustainable air transport policy document can aid the Amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1242 target by promoting sustainable aviation practices, reducing emissions, and improving air quality, which can support the development of sustainable and environmentally-friendly transportation systems.

The Aviation Fuel - Regulation (EU) 2023/2405 can have a significant positive impact on the Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy by promoting the use of sustainable aviation fuels, reducing emissions, and improving air quality, which can reinforce the strategy's objectives.
